confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are based on aggregated 2026 and recent travel-budget sources, but those sources conflict and some are undated or commercial estimates; wine and cocktail figures are the least certain. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season from general knowledge and the city context; no live booking pages or current listings were checked. The EUR-to-USD conversion uses an assumed rate of about 1.15 from general knowledge, not a searched source. The FX value comes from a search summary of rba.gov.au exchange-rate pages listing 0.6947 for 16 October 2026; the F11.1 table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against Madrid's own 2026 menu del dia (about EUR 12-15 with drink), a dining price index median of about EUR 16 per person, cappuccino at about EUR 3 in central areas, and draught beer at about EUR 3.5-4 in bars. Accommodation is benchmarked to other large southern European capitals in peak July season.
